page_title: BAR 1-0 OSA | Barcelona v Osasuna 31/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
89' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Aitor Fernandez is quickest to intercept the ball.
88' Good clearance! Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
87' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who has already been caught several times today.
86' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
85' The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
85' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
84' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Inaki Pena comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Here is a change. Lucas Torro is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Barja (Osasuna) replaces Jon Moncayola.
82' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
81' Osasuna concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
80' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
79' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
77' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Inaki Pena stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedri leaves the pitch and Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) comes on.
76' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
75' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.

74' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball has crossed the sideline. Osasuna are taking a throw-in.
73' The Osasuna players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
72' One of the Barcelona players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Aitor Fernandez thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
70' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul.
70' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aitor Fernandez intercepts the ball.
68' The substitution is prepared. Darko Brasanac (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aimar Oroz.
68' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Ante Budimir and he is replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
68' Substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
67' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) is given a yellow card by Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.
66' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
63' 1 - 0 Goal! Joao Cancelo picks out Vitor Roque (Barcelona) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the middle of the goal with a header from close range. 1:0.
62' That will be all from Fermin Lopez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
62' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
60' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
59' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
56' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
54' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) and blew his whistle.
53' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Pedri (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
52' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
50' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

49' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Barcelona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
49' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
48' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.

47' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Aitor Fernandez blocks the shot with his legs.
47' David Garcia (Osasuna) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
47' There's an opportunity for Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
46' The whistle blows and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
45+2' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+2' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
45+1' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A lofted cross from Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
43' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
43' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
43' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
40' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
40' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
39' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post.
38' Osasuna have a corner.
37' Half-chance! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Aitor Fernandez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
35' Ilkay Gundogan sends over an inswinging corner and Jules Kounde (Barcelona) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just over the bar.
35' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
35' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
33' David Garcia (Osasuna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
29' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
27' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
26' PENALTY APPEAL by Osasuna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
24' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Barcelona was in an offside position.
23' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), but the defence gets it clear.
21' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez sees the trip by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
20' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
19' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
18' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) attempts to find Pedri, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
16' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
16' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
14' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is adjudged offside.
13' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

12' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies yards wide of the left-hand post.
11' It seemed like Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
11' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul. Barcelona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' A long ball forward to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is intercepted.
9' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul.
8' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
7' Ferran Torres is substituted due to injury. Xavi gives a chance to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
6' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
5' Pedri (Barcelona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
4' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
2' The Barcelona players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession.
1' The match has just started.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez was nominated as the referee for this game.
